integrity_statement: Analytic proof supplied; rational and numerical checks are corroborative, not an independent audit or a substitute for quantifier-level proof.
scientific_limitations: Connected positive support; integer m >= 3 and positive linear prices; explicit unrestricted optimum but no classification of all asymmetric optimizers.
The conference source is dated July 24–28, 2006; an earlier online working-paper date has not been established.
Publication priority beyond the inspected sources remains subject to independent specialist review.
title: Four price phases in worst-pair resistance design on matching-priced \(K_{m,m}\)
